title: 第9章 我这有一块价值连城的宝石第10章 暴风城的灭门惨案
slug: 艾泽拉斯从掷骰子开始成神
lines: 力量，该去何处寻找力量呢？
在暴风城街头游荡的艾伦，满脑子都是这个问题。
他的第一反应是完成系统给的主线任务，那个需要他“编织一场伟大的骗局”的任务。
可他一路上走过来，顺手骗了几个路人，任务进度却纹丝不动。
或许是因为都是些微不足道的小骗局？
系统想要的，是一场真正伟大的骗局吗？
不知不觉间，艾伦一路骗到了圣光大教堂的面前。
他停下脚步，抬头望去。
圣光大教堂巍然矗立在暴风城的尽头，白色石墙在阳光下泛着圣洁的光芒。
庄严的圣歌从教堂深处隐隐传来，洗涤着每一个聆听者的心灵。
艾伦突发奇想。
既然系统的主线任务完成不了，不能解锁dnd的转职系统，那他可以去解锁魔兽世界的职业啊！
来都来了，试试看圣光是否眷顾自己。
他整了整衣襟，摆出一副虔诚的表情，混进了圣光大教堂。
教堂内部比外面看起来更加宏伟，一排排高大的石柱支撑着穹顶，彩色玻璃窗投下的光柱如同通往天堂的阶梯。
长椅上坐着零星的祈祷者，烛光在圣像前摇曳，空气中弥漫着熏香的味道。
艾伦四处张望，很快找到了目标，一位身穿白色长袍的女主教正在圣坛前整理烛台。
她面容慈祥，眼神温和，周身仿佛笼罩着一层淡淡的光晕。
艾伦快步上前，深深鞠了一躬：“尊敬的主教大人，我是一个来自远方的迷途者，今日终于来到圣光的殿堂。我……我想接受圣光洗礼，成为一名圣光的信徒！”
女主教转过身，目光柔和地注视着他：“孩子，圣光欢迎每一个真心寻求它的人。”
艾伦面上更加虔诚：“请为我祷告吧，我渴望感受圣光的温暖！”
女主教微笑着点了点头，抬手覆在艾伦的头顶，闭上双眼，开始低声祈祷。
那祷言古老而庄严，艾伦感觉到一股温暖的力量从头顶涌入，一开始只是温暖，然后迅速升温，变得灼热，最后——
“啊啊啊啊啊——！”
艾伦惨叫一声，整个人像被烫熟的虾米一样蜷缩起来，踉跄后退，差点撞翻身后的烛台。
他的皮肤泛起诡异的红色，头发隐隐冒烟。
女主教睁开眼，看着地上狼狈的艾伦，眼中闪过一丝了然。
“孩子，”她温和地说，“圣光并不适合你。”
艾伦揉着被烫得生疼的脑袋，欲哭无泪。
自己不仅不受圣光眷顾，还很怕圣光？为什么？
事已至此，眼看是没法当牧师了，艾伦看向那位女主教。
既然圣光之路走不通，那就……
“好吧，不过尊敬的主教大人，”他从怀中掏出一块翠绿色的石头，“我这有一块价值连城的宝石，乃是百年难得一见的奥术水晶！您看这成色，这光泽，简直是百年难遇的珍品！现在我便宜卖给您，只要一个金币，怎么样？”
为了感谢艾伦，临行前，法雷老板将艾伦之前捡到的短剑送给了他，还送了一大袋孔雀石。
孔雀石听起来好像是宝石，实际上只是艾泽拉斯铜矿的一种伴生矿物，完全不值钱，连一铜币都不值。
属于是拿在身上都嫌占地方，为了不浪费，艾伦便一路骗着想把这一袋孔雀石卖出去。
【欺瞒检定：失败】
女主教静静地注视着他，那双眼睛仿佛能看透一切伪装。
然后，她笑了。
她抬起手，轻轻摸了摸艾伦的头，那动作如同慈爱的母亲抚慰顽皮的孩子。
“孩子，”她轻声说，“圣光会原谅你的。”

Strength, where should we find strength?
Allen was wandering the streets of Stormwind City with this question in his mind.
His first reaction was to complete the main task given by the system, a task that required him to "weave a great scam."
But along the way, he deceived a few passers-by, but the progress of the mission remained unchanged.
Maybe it's because they're all trivial scams?
Is what the system wants, a truly great scam?
Unknowingly, Allen deceived him all the way to the Cathedral of Holy Light.
He stopped and looked up.
The Cathedral of Holy Light stands majestically at the end of Stormwind City, its white stone walls glowing with holy light in the sun.
The solemn hymns came faintly from the depths of the church, washing the hearts of everyone who listened.
Allen had a sudden idea.
Since the main mission of the system cannot be completed and the job transfer system of dnd cannot be unlocked, then he can unlock the job of World of Warcraft!
Come here, try to see if the Holy Light cares for you.
He straightened his clothes, put on a pious expression, and sneaked into the Holy Light Cathedral.
The interior of the church is more majestic than the outside, with rows of tall stone pillars supporting the dome, and the light beams cast by the stained glass windows are like stairs to heaven.
Scattered prayers sat on the benches, candlelight flickered in front of the icon, and the smell of incense filled the air.
Allen looked around and quickly found his target. A female bishop in white robes was arranging candlesticks in front of the altar.
She had a kind face and gentle eyes, and her whole body seemed to be enveloped by a faint halo.
Allen quickly stepped forward and bowed deeply: "Dear Bishop, I am a lost person from afar, and I finally came to the temple of the Holy Light today. I... I want to be baptized by the Holy Light and become a believer in the Holy Light!"
The female bishop turned around and looked at him softly: "My child, the Holy Light welcomes everyone who sincerely seeks it."
Allen's face became more pious: "Please pray for me, I long to feel the warmth of the holy light!"
The female bishop smiled and nodded, raised her hands to cover Allen's head, closed her eyes, and began to pray in a low voice.
The prayer was ancient and solemn, and Allen felt a warm power pouring in from the top of his head. It was just warm at first, then quickly heated up, becoming scorching, and finally——
"Ahhhhhh-!"
Allen screamed, curled up like a scalded shrimp, staggered back, and almost knocked over the candlestick behind him.
His skin was a strange red, and his hair was smoking faintly.
The female bishop opened her eyes and looked at the embarrassed Allen on the ground, with a flash of understanding in her eyes.
"Son," she said gently, "the Light is not for you."
Allen rubbed his sore head, wanting to cry without tears.
Not only am I not favored by the Holy Light, but I am also afraid of the Holy Light? Why?
At this point, seeing that he could no longer be a priest, Allen looked at the female bishop.
Since the road to Holy Light is unavailable, then...
"Okay, but dear Bishop," he took out an emerald green stone from his arms, "I have a priceless gem here, which is an arcane crystal that is rare to see in a hundred years! Look at the color and luster, it is a rare treasure that can only be seen in a hundred years! Now I will sell it to you cheaply, for only one gold coin, how about it?"
In order to thank Allen, before leaving, Boss Farley gave him the dagger that Allen had picked up before, and also gave him a large bag of malachite.
Malachite sounds like a gem, but it is actually just an associated mineral from the copper mines of Azeroth. It is completely worthless, not even worth a copper coin.
It took up too much space to carry on the body, so in order not to waste it, Allen lied all the way to try to sell this bag of malachite.
[Deception check: failed]
The female bishop stared at him quietly, her eyes seemed to be able to see through all disguises.
Then she smiled.
She raised her hand and gently touched Allen's head. Her action was like a loving mother soothing a naughty child.
"My child," she whispered, "the Light will forgive you."
